subject.title: Feature Request: Voice Recognition / Speaker Identification for Voice Interface

question: Should OpenClaw add speaker-recognition gating to native and realtime voice input, and what enrollment, storage, threshold, provider-egress, fallback, and platform scope should govern it?
rationale: The request affects who can trigger voice actions and how sensitive voice data is stored or sent to providers, so automation cannot choose the product and security boundary safely.

options.title: Design the speaker-gating contract first
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers define the native hook, storage model, provider egress rules, fallback UX, and plugin/API boundary before code.

options.title: Prototype behind a plugin or provider seam
options.body: Use a plugin/API design discussion or experimental provider path first, proving the extension point before adding bundled voice enrollment UI.

options.title: Defer as too risky for now
options.body: Close or park the feature until OpenClaw has stronger voice-auth policy because speaker verification is not a strong authentication factor by itself.

recommendation.title: Design the speaker-gating contract first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers define the native hook, storage model, provider egress rules, fallback UX, and plugin/API boundary before code.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history makes steipete the strongest routing candidate across macOS Voice Wake, Android voice capture, iOS Talk, and provider-facing Talk work.
